# netbox_custom_field (Data Source)

Retrieves a single custom field from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_field" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "custom_field_id" {
  value = data.netbox_custom_field.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the custom field.

### Read-Only

- `choice_set_id` (Number) The ID of the choice set associated with the custom field.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the custom field.
- `created` (String) When the custom field was created.
- `data_type` (String) The data type of the custom field.
- `default` (String) The default of the custom field.
- `description` (String) A description of the custom field.
- `filter_logic` (String) The filter logic of the custom field.
- `group_name` (String) The group name of the custom field.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_cloneable` (Boolean) The is cloneable of the custom field.
- `label` (String) The label of the custom field.
- `last_updated` (String) When the custom field was last changed.
- `nulls_first` (Boolean) The nulls first of the custom field.
- `object_types` (List of String) The object types of the custom field.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the custom field.
- `related_object_filter` (String) The related object filter of the custom field.
- `related_object_type` (String) The related object type of the custom field.
- `required` (Boolean) The required of the custom field.
- `search_weight` (Number) The search weight of the custom field.
- `status` (String) The status of the custom field.
- `type` (String) The type of the custom field.
- `ui_editable` (String) The ui editable of the custom field.
- `ui_visible` (String) The ui visible of the custom field.
- `unique` (Boolean) The unique of the custom field.
- `validation_maximum` (Number) The validation maximum of the custom field.
- `validation_minimum` (Number) The validation minimum of the custom field.
- `validation_regex` (String) The validation regex of the custom field.
- `validation_schema` (String) The validation schema of the custom field.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the custom field.
